fixtureEvidenceNature: Controlled synthetic review-stage data. No real business execution, original project/session access, or model call occurred while constructing these cases.

M08.promptAppend: M08 checks only the assigned Skill obligation in this invocation. Check the captured original Skill source for its mandatory force, scope, conditions and exceptions; a derived MUST label, prose order or tool-name preference cannot strengthen it. Bind relevant original tool calls to their results and invocation. Equivalent complete reads count when the source allows them. For modification limits inspect effects of exec, scripts, output paths and redirections as well as write/edit tools; a path mention alone is not a modification. Historical ordering requires an explicit source relation and attributable action/result order, not an assistant admission or observer change. A failed required check followed by a successful authorized retry may comply. Source code or a completion claim is not proof that a Skill action occurred. A supported contradiction is DEVIATION; missing original source, ambiguous ownership or unavailable action results is UNVERIFIED. Do not prescribe code changes to erase a past event.

M09.promptAppend: M09 checks the assigned mandatory development standard against the current evidence owner. Read the original standard and its applicability; do not invent style rules, preferred libraries, runtime gates or stronger limits. For source-owned standards inspect the actual input/data/control path and necessary dependencies, including language edge cases; comments and a compliant wrapper do not prove the called implementation. A concrete violation of this standard is DEVIATION. PASS needs each applicable clause supported at this scope; missing required dependencies or process/runtime evidence is UNVERIFIED. Do not fail the source merely because an unrelated application feature or full-project test is outside this object.

M10.promptAppend: M10 checks one mandatory experience rule, not general code quality or optional advice. Preserve the original trigger, permitted alternatives and exceptions. If a conditional rule is established applicable, inspect the actual implementation or original process evidence required by that rule; names, comments and claimed compliance do not suffice. Do not mistake a missing witness for a known violation, or assume a trigger absent because the supplied excerpt omits it. A concrete rule-breaking path supports DEVIATION; necessary unavailable dependencies, trigger facts or action results require UNVERIFIED. PASS applies only to the supported assigned rule and scope. Do not add runtime demands to a source-inspectable rule.

M11.promptAppend: M11 checks the original fixed workflow for this task, using original business tool history. Only an explicit mandatory sequence, gate or action is enforceable; numbered prose alone creates no new ordering rule. Match actions to the same resources and invocation. Successful A output before B invocation can prove A completed before B started; call order, overlapping/batched calls, a planned command or missing/failed output cannot prove successful completion. Inspect attributable arguments and results, including effects of exec and scripts. Do not attribute reviewer/observer actions to the business agent. Concrete mandatory-order or gate contradictions are DEVIATION; incomplete or ambiguous history is UNVERIFIED. Current artifacts and self-reports cannot retrospectively prove history, and repeating actions cannot erase a confirmed past violation.

M13.promptAppend: M13 asks whether this assigned acceptance criterion is closed by appropriate evidence, not whether its wording or implementation looks plausible. Identify every required observation and the authorized scope. Where execution is required, bind actual tool input and result to this criterion, relevant data/resources and current implementation identity; inspect exit status, asserted behavior and required state effects. A test plan, source code, checkmark, success title or assistant claim alone is not a run result. A captured failure or wrong observed result is DEVIATION. Missing, stale, partial or unbound results are UNVERIFIED; never import another criterion or source-only PASS as closure. Do not demand device/runtime evidence when the original criterion permits a document/static check.

M14.promptAppend: M14 checks only the assigned milestone gate and all of its stated exit conditions. Determine its actual deliverables, dependency gates and evidence type from the original basis; a documentation milestone need not implement or execute the future app. Verify each conjunct with current artifacts or attributable execution/approval evidence as required. A milestone label, checklist tick, partial deliverable or another milestone PASS is not closure. A concrete unmet or contradicted gate is DEVIATION; unavailable approval, dependency or required result evidence is UNVERIFIED. Respect explicit deferrals and permitted alternatives without waiving mandatory conditions, and do not expand this milestone into whole-project acceptance.

M15.promptAppend: M15 checks the assigned critical journey as a connected path from its preconditions through all required actions to the final observable outcome. Preserve actor, scenario, resources/state, implementation identity, conditions and required persistence or failure boundaries. For an execution journey, bind original tool actions/results across that same path; isolated component successes, unrelated stores/sessions, source code and narrative walkthroughs cannot establish an end-to-end pass. A concrete failing transition or wrong final outcome is DEVIATION. Missing, stale or unlinked journey evidence is UNVERIFIED. Do not add unrelated journeys or require runtime execution where the authoritative task explicitly asks only for a document-level journey.

M09.caveat: Respect existing verificationTarget; do not force process standards into source proof.

M10.caveat: Only mandatory original rule; applicability conditions and alternatives remain intact.

M11.caveat: Always original business tool history, never source-only implementation review.

M13.caveat: Use appropriate evidence owner; documents/static acceptance must not acquire an invented runtime gate.

M14.caveat: User-defined milestone may close from document gates; do not demand future phases.

M15.caveat: Connected scenario/resources/state for execution journeys, with permitted doc-only exceptions.
